criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.

Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given a support request, when it is pasted into the assistant, then it should be classified into a predefined category.
Given a support request, when it is classified, then the assistant should determine its priority.
Trust: The classification and priority determination should be logged in the audit trail.
Given a classified support request, when I review it, then I can approve or reject the classification and priority.
Given a misclassified support request, when I reject it, then it is sent back for reclassification.
Trust: Every approval or rejection action is logged in the audit trail.
Given an action on a support request, when it occurs, then it is logged in the audit trail.
Given a failed logging attempt, when it occurs, then an alert is generated.
Trust: The audit trail is immutable and records all actions accurately.
Given a classified request, when the assistant searches the knowledge base, then it should return relevant troubleshooting steps.
Given a search, when no relevant steps are found, then the assistant should indicate uncertainty.
Trust: The search query and results should be logged in the audit trail.
Given troubleshooting steps, when the assistant generates a response, then it should be professional and based on available information.
Given a response draft, when I review it, then I should be able to edit it before sending.
Trust: The draft generation should be logged in the audit trail.

criteria.text: Given an unresolved issue, when the assistant recommends escalation, then it should provide a clear explanation.
Given an escalation recommendation, when I review it, then I should be able to approve or reject it.
Trust: The escalation recommendation and decision should be logged in the audit trail.

criteria.text: Given a completed workflow, when the assistant generates a support summary, then it should include all relevant details.
Given a support summary, when I review it, then I should be able to save it manually.
Trust: The summary generation should be logged in the audit trail.
